text:
Ava (Marketing): Hey team — first full draft of the product post is up. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/product-post-v1 please skim for claims + CTA.
Sam (Content): scanning now. Lede is a bit long, suggest a 1-sentence hook then stat.
Diego (Product): Can we add a short benchmark bullet for 99th p90 latency vs older infra? one line with numbers.
Ava (Marketing): Good call — Sam, Diego: okay if I add a single parenthetical stat after the second paragraph?
Sam (Content): yes that works. also tighten the transition into the demo section.
Marisol (Design): Hero image mock uploaded to figma, filename: hero-serve-performance.png. Need alt text and microcopy for hero CTA.
Noah (Growth): We'll want a registration CTA that drives webinar attendees + gated benchmark PDF. CTA text: "See benchmarks + join webinar" — is that okay?
Priya (Legal): Quick note: avoid absolute claims like "fastest" unless you add comparator context. Also need citation for the benchmark numbers.
Ava (Marketing): noted. I'll reword any absolutes to "up to" and add footnote for the test harness. Diego, can you paste the test link?
Diego (Product): paste: https://bench.redwood.ai/serving/2026-run-07 — contains raw numbers and config. Use that as citation.
Priya (Legal): I reviewed the changed phrasing in the doc and the footnote link — OK with that wording. one minor tweak to the data retention sentence, will comment in the doc.
Sam (Content): Edited lead down to one sentence, moved demo closer to the CTA. Also added a micro headline: "Predictable inference at scale".
Marisol (Design): Alt text suggestion: "Dashboard showing latency and throughput improvements on Redwood Dedicated". CTA button design ready.
Noah (Growth): Webinar date pinned to May 12 — I'll wire up the registration page. Can we confirm speaker list? Ava + Diego + someone from infra.
Ava (Marketing): I'll confirm infra speaker — pinging @Tyler on infra. Tyler, are you available May 12?
PublishBot: preview build for /blog/product-inference published: https://preview.redwood.ai/product-inference/v1 — status: SUCCESS
Tyler (Infra): yep, May 12 works. happy to do a short segment on kv-cache + batching.
Ava (Marketing): Awesome. Final approvals: Priya (legal) ✅, Marisol (design) ✅, Sam (content) ✅. Diego — do you sign off on the benchmark phrasing?
Diego (Product): Signed off. wording: "up to 3.2x lower per-token latency in our internal benchmark (see footnote)" — fine.
Noah (Growth): I'll set up the gated PDF download and ensure HubSpot flows map to webinar registrants -> demo follow-up.
Ava (Marketing): Great — plan: I’ll push final draft by 10:30 PT, schedule publish for 1:00 PT after a final check. If no blockers by 12:30 PT, we go live.
Priya (Legal): One quick doc comment left, likely resolved in 10 min. After resolved, legal is green.
Sam (Content): small nit fixed.
Ava (Marketing): all set, thanks everyone. :rocket:
